title: Royal Bank of Canada Launches Enterprise Quantum Strategy and Academic Workforce Pipelines - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Royal Bank of Canada launched a multi-year enterprise quantum strategy covering internal R&D on financial modeling, PQC/QKD migration, Xanadu-hosted developer training with PennyLane, talent partnerships with Waterloo IQC and U of Toronto, and an equity stake in Photonic Inc. from its C$180M round.

insights.claim: RBC launched a multi-year enterprise quantum strategy spanning internal R&D, post-quantum cybersecurity migration, academic workforce initiatives and direct hardware equity positions.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Large banks formalizing quantum programs signals enterprise demand for quantum software, PQC services and talent.
